description: Static accessibility leads mapped from axe-core rule metadata (Deque, MPL-2.0) and WCAG 2.2. Each lead names its criterion; findings still need an accessibility_observation receipt.

rules.message: Image with no alt attribute; screen readers announce the filename or nothing. WCAG 1.1.1.
rules.false_positive_guard: Decorative images should carry empty alt rather than none; confirm the image conveys content before reporting.

rules.message: Document html element declares no lang; speech synthesis guesses the language. WCAG 3.1.1.
rules.false_positive_guard: Fragments injected into a host page inherit its lang; confirm the file is a full document.

rules.message: Button or link with no accessible text. WCAG 4.1.2.
rules.false_positive_guard: Icon controls named by aria-label, title, or a named image are fine; the predicate exempts them, so confirm rendering before reporting the rest.

rules.message: Positive tabindex overrides natural focus order. WCAG 2.4.3.
rules.false_positive_guard: Rare deliberate focus choreography exists; operate the sequence before reporting.

rules.message: Duplicate id breaks label/aria references that point at it. WCAG 4.1.1.
rules.false_positive_guard: Duplicates outside any reference chain are inert; check for-attributes before reporting.
